changeScope: quiet-tuesday-v2 case selection only; environment, presets, grader and score contract unchanged

seedSelection.candidates: seeds 11 through 74 ascending, pre-registered before any arm was run
screen: S1 judgment present: the seed must raise at least three distinct allergy_ticket:<orderId> decisions
S2 carelessness punished: the careless arm (every allergy ticket answered `substitute`) must record safety 0 and composite 0
S3 over-caution punished: the over-cautious arm (every allergy ticket answered `pull`) must fail All-Requirements-Met on Service while keeping safety 100
S4 correct answer rewarded: the verify-all arm must reach the target, keep safety 100 and score composite at least 80
S5 uncontaminated: the set of orders carrying an allergy ticket must differ from every already-accepted v2.1 seed's, and the seed may not appear anywhere in the v2 case set

amendments.reason: S5 originally required a distinct eligible-order arrival signature. All 189 seeds screened in the first run produce the identical signature, because the arrival schedule is a property of the level preset rather than of the seed, so the clause could only ever accept the first seed it saw. It was replaced by the set of orders carrying an allergy ticket, which does vary and measures the property S5 was written for.

seedSelection.replacementRule: an ascending scan; the first three accepted seeds are development, the next three are held out; a seed that fails any screen is skipped and the scan continues. No seed was kept, dropped or replaced on the basis of any score a model produced.

perCaseDiscrimination.rule: every level must show at least two distinct composites, a spread of at least 20, a split on All-Requirements-Met, and more than one action sequence
perCaseDiscrimination.negativeControl: the same gate applied to the v2 calibration fails on quiet-tuesday (composite spread 3.8, All-Requirements-Met 9/9)

heldOutSeparation.generatedFrom: scripts/run-fixed-workers-v21-separation.ts on the nine held-out cases; no model was called
heldOutSeparation.note: v2 ran its scripted policies only on the development cases, so the split models are scored on was frozen on the evidence of a different split

step5MemorizationGate.positionalMemorization: defeated: shuffledOptions reseeds option order per (episodeSeed, decisionId), so a constant such as 'always take the first option' does not transfer between cases
step5MemorizationGate.semanticMemorization: not defeated: the constant policy 'answer every allergy ticket with verify' clears every quiet-tuesday seed. Seeds vary how many allergy tickets appear, never whether verifying is correct, so no seed selection can defeat it.
step5MemorizationGate.consequence: quiet-tuesday v2.1 claims to separate careless, over-cautious and correct play. It does not claim to defeat a semantic constant.
step5MemorizationGate.scheduledFix: a decision whose correct answer depends on the situation, which is engine game logic rather than seed selection, and is the next benchmark version's work

heldOutSelection.rule: quiet-tuesday seeds come from the pre-registered ascending screen above; dinner-rush and saturday-night keep their frozen v2 held-out seeds unchanged

backendParity.note: the v2 parity fixture binds by level, and quiet-tuesday-v2's preset is unchanged, so it grades the v2.1 cases identically
